implementation_behavior: The reader consumes decoded Unicode scalars and reports iterator decoding failures.
limit: Malformed byte handling belongs to the byte-to-scalar decoder, before the GSLT carrier.

implementation_behavior: A semicolon at atom position begins a comment.
limit: Exact comment diagnostics and source ranges are outside the valid-source relation.

implementation_behavior: Every scalar satisfying Rust char.is_whitespace is layout.
limit: The exhaustive scalar-class gate is tied to the Rust toolchain used by the pinned authority checkout.

implementation_behavior: A dollar sign at atom position selects variable parsing before word parsing.
limit: Priority is represented structurally by excluding dollar from word starts.

implementation_behavior: An opening parenthesis at atom position selects recursive expression parsing.
limit: The production reader still needs the compiled semantic action path.

implementation_behavior: A closing parenthesis at top level is an error and consumes the remaining source as leftovers.
limit: The GSLT valid-source relation rejects it; exact recovery tree and diagnostic text are separate.

implementation_behavior: A double quote at token start selects string parsing.
limit: String value construction is the current finite-state transducer obligation.

implementation_behavior: Every other token start selects word parsing.
limit: The word-start class excludes branches selected earlier by the authority.

implementation_behavior: Rust HE consumes a comment through every scalar except line feed; the written HE EOL production also terminates at carriage return.
limit: The ratified GSLT follows the written CR-or-LF production; Rust HE, CeTTa he-compat, and LeaTTa require conformance fixes.

implementation_behavior: Inside parentheses comments and whitespace are trivia and remaining atoms recurse until close.
limit: Syntax-node trivia and source ranges are intentionally erased by the Atom relation.

implementation_behavior: End of input before the matching close parenthesis is an error.
limit: The valid-source relation rejects it; exact ErrorGroup recovery is separate.

implementation_behavior: An unescaped double quote closes the string and is retained in the authority token text.
limit: The canonical GSLT node records the decoded token value rather than the authority SyntaxNode range.

implementation_behavior: Backslash followed by quote, apostrophe, backslash, n, r, or t decodes one scalar.
limit: The semantic transducer must preserve the decoded scalar, not the source spelling.

implementation_behavior: Backslash-x consumes exactly two hexadecimal digits and accepts only values at most 0x7f.
limit: Failure after consuming an invalid pair is represented as invalid source, not a literal fallback.

implementation_behavior: Rust HE accepts empty bodies, repeated opening braces, and up to eight digits; the ratified extension requires exactly one brace and one through six digits.
limit: The GSLT accepts exactly Unicode scalar values through 0x10ffff and rejects surrogates and noncanonical source envelopes.

implementation_behavior: Every unrecognized or malformed escape produces an invalid string token.
limit: Exact error spans and messages are outside the valid-source relation.

implementation_behavior: End of input before a closing quote is an error.
limit: The valid-source relation rejects it; exact incomplete-node construction is separate.

implementation_behavior: Whitespace, open parenthesis, close parenthesis, semicolon, or end of input terminates a word.
limit: Maximal extent is a consumer policy certified by the guarded cursor plan.

implementation_behavior: Quote, dollar, and hash are ordinary word-tail scalars after a non-special word start.
limit: Quote is special only at token start; dollar is special only at atom start.

implementation_behavior: Rust HE terminates a variable at whitespace or parentheses but not semicolon; the written production excludes semicolon from the name.
limit: The ratified GSLT terminates before semicolon while preserving quote as an ordinary variable-tail scalar.

implementation_behavior: Rust HE constructs an empty-name variable for bare dollar; the written VARIABLE production requires at least one following scalar.
limit: The ratified dispatch rejects bare dollar rather than inventing an empty variable or silently changing it into a word.

implementation_behavior: Rust HE accepts both semicolon and quote inside a variable token; the written production permits quote but excludes semicolon.
limit: The ratified GSLT preserves interior quote and terminates the variable before a semicolon comment.

implementation_behavior: Hash inside a variable is reserved and turns the remainder into an error.
limit: The class excludes hash; exact leftover recovery is separate.

implementation_behavior: A complete variable token constructs a variable Atom from the spelling after dollar.
limit: Variable allocation identity is normalized by spelling in the canonical comparison.

implementation_behavior: With the empty tokenizer, complete string and word tokens construct symbol Atoms from decoded token text.
limit: Runtime tokenizer registrations are a separate versioned semantic environment.

implementation_behavior: An expression recursively constructs ordered child Atoms while comments, whitespace, and parentheses contribute no Atom.
limit: Syntax-node ranges and trivia remain available only in the separate syntax-tree surface.

implementation_behavior: Repeated parsing skips trivia and returns the ordered top-level Atom stream until end of input.
limit: Top-level execution policy is not part of SExprParser Atom construction.

implementation_behavior: Configured regular-expression constructors may replace word or string symbols with grounded Atoms.
limit: The current HE authority profile is explicitly the empty-tokenizer reader; registered tokenizers need their own LanguageDef environment.

implementation_behavior: Top-level execution markers are interpreted by the program-loading layer rather than SExprParser.
limit: Full HE program-source correspondence requires a separately versioned loader presentation.
